Ever since Phainon crossed the doors to the building, the mix of anxiety and excitement hadn’t left him for even a second, both a blessing and a curse. The number of times he left his designated place to go to the bathroom and stare at the toilet, gambling whether the lunch prepared by his partner is gonna leave his body the same way it went in, was embarrassingly high.

“Pardon,” He said apologetically, squeezing between two occupied tables yet again. ‘The organizers really should’ve gone for a bigger hall’, he thought to himself.

The stream on Threads started just as Phainon sank down on his seat, the busy cameramen moved around them in a precise, coordinated arrangement.

A sudden, shy tug on Phainon's pants made him look to the left, in a direction of another streamer that sat next to him. “Are you okay?” The young woman asked as she leaned closer, the smell of her cedar perfume filling Phainon's nose. Her face was adorned with big black glasses that contrasted with the light purple colour of her hair. Her hair was pinned neatly in a formal manner, revealing her neck.

Phainon didn’t expect that someone would strike a conversation with him, especially after he managed to annoy every single table on the way to his many adventures to the bathroom. He stared at her for a short while, bright blue eyes wide before he finally opened his mouth to answer. “Y-yeah.”

“Nervous?”

“Very much so,” He tried to be honest, smile and pretend to have everything under control at the same time, but his voice quivered. He could feel his cheeks flushing pink almost immediately.

The woman's slender fingers covered her mouth as she giggled. “Give me your hand,” Phainon did as she said, blinking twice when a small plushie-like grey cat figure appeared in his hand. His brows furrowed at its weird texture. She sensed that Phainon didn't understand what exactly that was. “Come on, just squish it.”

As he mashed it in his hands, the cat slowly poured out from the sides where his palm wasn't touching. “A slime?” Phainon laughed, fixated on the changing cat’s features and the colourful insides. It’s face reminded him of Mydei.

“Something like that. My girlfriend made it,” Her face softened after the mention of her partner, a warm smile growing on her face. “It helps me a lot with my anxiety.”

“Your girlfriend?” Phainon didn’t mean to sound as shocked as he did. He noticed the panic on her pale face and almost panicked himself. “Oh, no, nothing wrong with it! I too- I’m also gay,” He came even closer despite her body moving away subconsciously, his voice much lower.

“Really?” She put a hand on her mouth to hide the surprise, her body slowly relaxing.

Phainon nodded. They exchanged smiles until he noticed their interaction shown on one of the big screens. Abashed, both turned away from each other, smiling awkwardly.

“By the way, I’m Castorice,” She said, her gaze focused on the main stage. Phainon glanced at her for a quick second.

“Nice to meet you,” He replied, pretending to be interested in what was happening ahead.

Phainon didn’t even realise he kept playing with the toy from his new friend, squishing and wiggling it in his hand to calm his nerves.

⋆⭒˚.⋆☽◯☾ ⋆⭒˚.⋆

The performances and small skits were amazing, and most awards were already given out. The whole time Phainon had to physically stop himself from wincing at the cameras that seemed to focus heavily on him and Castorice, as if hoping to catch them doing something again, something that would spark a rumor or some sort of controversy.

He did a pretty good job of ignoring them, but he couldn't stop thinking of all the things the chatters might have been typing for them to act like that. I hope Mydei's not reading the chat, he thought.

The familiar happy tune filled the whole hall, signaling that the award of The Best Golden Thread Streamer was soon to be announced.

"This is so nerve-wracking," Castorice mumbled, playing with her hands.

"But so exciting," Phainon added, gently taking her hand and finally returning the anxiety plushie to it’s rightful owner. She nodded her head as a shy 'thank you', her face red. Castorice didn't think Phainon would hear her mumbling with the already deafening sounds all around them.

He might've fooled Castorice, but the way his body shivered from the nerves betrayed his state to everyone else. Who could blame him, though? It felt unreal to sit at one of these tables and be one of the nominated streamers instead of watching everything live on Threads like he always did. If seven years ago, when he started streaming out of boredom, someone told him that he will compete with big shots like Guinaifen or Sparkle for an award everyone on Threads wanted, he would've laughed in their face. Even now it sounds ridiculous. Maybe they mistook him for someone else when sending the invite and showing the nominations?

His heartbeat was loud and it soon felt like he could barely hear his surroundings. Everything felt like a mix of sounds and senses that painfully made itself known in his chest. Phainon didn't even realise he was bouncing his, now very much in pain, leg this whole time.

He felt a tug on the arm of his suit and looked to the left, meeting Castorice's worried expression. "Is everything alright?" She asked, analysing him. "You look very pale."

Phainon swallowed the excess saliva in his mouth that be didn't know was there. He barely heard the question. "Yes?" Playing it cool wasn't exactly the smartest idea while he looked like Casper the Friendly Ghost and he knew that. It was too late to back down though.

"Should we get some fresh air?" She slid the chair a bit and moved her legs to the side, ready to leave. "You look like you're about to pass out."

Leaving at that moment would mean missing out on the announcement. He didn't have high hopes of winning and yet this is something Phainon couldn't afford to do. Not after so much time and energy that have been put into streaming throughout these past 7 years that weren't exactly the most calm and considerate of him. He had his ups and downs like everyone else, but he always got up fast, especially with the support and care of his lovely boyfriend.

Right. Mydei. He was definitely watching him in that exact moment, he said he would.

"Phainon?" Castorice's voice snapped him out of his thoughts. She moved the bottle of water in her hand in front of his face. He squinted his eyes at the coldness he was able to sense from it. "Drink this."

He took and opened it, chugging down a few big gulps. He could feel the ice cold water throughout his whole body, a refreshing feeling overtaking the anxiety and lightheadedness.

"Thank you." He wiped his lips from the excess water that spilled on his suit and pants. "I'm feeling better now, thank you, Castorice." He flashed a smile that she reciprocated, although her face showed a hint of worry still lingering inside of her.

Phainon finally focused on the stage where Aglaea, the founder of Golden Threads, stood. She always announced the last award, a well-known and loved tradition, a distinction for one's work. This year's dress of hers was a cream formal gown with small hints of a desaturated teal in the form of embroidery. The corset she wore was transparent on the sides, displaying her figure and delicate skin and it reminded Phainon of an armour breastplate. It contained the same fancywork, embellished with porcelain metal flowers and chains, as well as some hints of gold. The chains connected the corset to the upper piece - a pauldrons in a shape of a turtleneck adorned with shiny light sequins and the same sea-green pattern as elsewhere. The sleeves were long and transparent, ending in an abundance of material with the same type of decorations at her top piece, beautifully contrasting with her pale skin and complementing her ivory nails.

The whole upper body garment seemed hard to walk and move in, yet she displayed a perfect movement in it, elegant as always.

She tugged a strand of her hair behind her right ear. "I, once again, would like to thank the sponsors, the streamers and the chatters for making it possible for us to be here today." Her voice spread across the hall. "Now, for the moment everyone was waiting for." She smiled as two graceful women from both of her sides aligned themselves with her. One of them held the statuette of a golden apple while the other opened a golden envelope. It took her a few seconds to read it.

The blind founder inclined her head towards the whispering woman. Aglaea cleared her throat. "The winner of 'The Best Streamer Award is…" The pause made everyone hold their breath. Castorice swiftly took Phainon's hand in hers out of excitement and anticipation, both of them eager to know the lucky winner.

"Neikos496!"

The whole hall boomed with the sounds of cheers, clapping and happy screams. Phainon froze, only allowing the purple headed woman next to him to swiftly jerk her hand away before the cameras and everyone's stares found them. His eyes and mouth were wide open. Castorice, on the other hand, snapped her head with a big "o" on her face that quickly turned into her biggest smile that evening.

He met Cas' gaze for a short second and started standing up to make his way to the stage, his body felt weird, as if everything was a dream. The three women were patiently waiting for him.

He climbed a few stairs and stood in front of them, a mix of emotions adoring his face. Aglaea was first to make a move, embracing him in a congratulatory hug. "Great job. Congratulations." Her body was warm and soft, just like her voice. Phainon felt like he could cry, the praise felt almost maternal.

When she pulled away, he took the statuette from the shorter woman's offering hands, finally turning around to face the audience that was still rooting for him with various sounds.

He gulped and smiled, although a bit awkwardly. "Hi, um, I honestly do not know what to say," he laughed to ease his nerves. It didn't help much. "I honestly did not expect to receive this award, but I am n-nevertheless very happy about it." The momentarily stutter didn't help him de-stress, but he decided to push through.

"I became a streamer on a whim and never expected to reach this many people to the point of being here, today, with you. I would like to thank my parents for supporting me financially at the rough start." He smiled at the end, warm memories flooding his mind. He still remember the excitement he felt when they surprised him with a new microphone to help his channel. "But I think the biggest thanks should go to my p-" He stopped, unsure.

Would coming out at that moment be worth it? The platform was LGBTQ+ friendly, it was one of the safest places for people like him and he was contemplating finally saying something. Was it the right move? What would Mydei think about it? What if he won't like it? He cherished his partner so much and would scream it at the top of his lungs if he could, but there were never a moment to bring it up. Mydei had also never said anything about wanting to make things official, although none of his chatter knew that he exists.

Ah, fuck it.

Phainon cleared his throat and relaxed his shoulders. "My par- my boyfriend, my dear Mydeimos, my first fan and chatter who supported me every single day in my career. I don't think I would be here today if it wasn't for him." People became even louder than previously, shouting all sorts of positive comments while clapping and whistling. He looked at one of the nearest cameras. "I know he's watching it right now. I love you, honeycake." He winked, his smile wide and sincere as he raised the statuette up to welcome the last ovations before returning to his seat and extremely pumped up Castorice.

"You're crazy!!" She whisper-yelled at him, laughing. "What is Mydeimos gonna think?"

The blond man was sitting on the couch, wrapped up in a fuzzy pink blanket. He was hugging a long white cat plushie while watching the stream on his phone. The dead silence before the announcement was stressing him out, his left hand knuckles travelled to his lips, his facial expressions serious.

"Neikos496!"

Mydei inhaled sharply, a sudden gush of pride and joy made him rise forward, a whole hand on his open mouth.

He watched as his boyfriend went on the stage and smirked at how nervous he was. He looked adorable. And very handsome, especially with that suit of his. The first part of his speech made Mydei coo, as he recalled the past he was lucky enough to experience with Phainon, watching him being all giddy from the amount of help received from Audata and Hieronymus.

It was during the next part where he started at his phone, blinking a few times. He slowly slid down the couch, his body absorbed by the blanket and all additional pillows as his cheeks turning red at the petname and wink Phainon did.

He didn't expect his partner to come out, but a part of him breathed a sigh of relief. He hated to admit, but the way people on the Internet talked about him and the way the cameras focused on Phainon with that woman sitting next to him made his stomach twist. Not a single word has been muttered because he knew the man loves him, but the way people were so fast to try and pair him with someone started to get on his nerves. That's his Phainon.

"HKS…" The phone was gently thrown next to him as both of his hands made contact with the flushed face. The livestream was still on, the various wishes to Phainon heard on the other side. One of the cats, curious, rubbed its little head against Mydei's hand, but all the man could answer with was a shy groan.

His hand played around with the glass of alcohol he was served, not really keen on drinking more.

It was hard for Phainon to get drunk, but it didn’t mean he liked to do so. Most likely due to the influence of his boyfriend during their university years, but he didn’t complain. Less alcohol consumption improved his life in many areas.

He walked around the party, the feeling of weariness slowly catching up to him. He was able to relax and even made a few new contacts for possible future collabs, but the best thing was the amount of comments and praises he had gotten about his coming out and Mydei. People seemed to adore his boyfriend, especially from what Phainon happily described to them. Different reactions appeared when it came to showing a picture of him. Phainon couldn't count how many people had their jaws hit the ground. ‘That’s the man that bakes for you?’ was one of the most frequent question asked. Yes, it was indeed him.

He couldn’t physically stop himself from smiling at the recollection of the conversations. His gaze met with the glass again. Phainon swirled the alcohol and tried taking another sip. The bitter liquid slid down his throat as his face scrunched. After shaking his head it was time to start scanning the room in hopes of seeing a good place to leave the cup at. There's no way he's gonna finish that.

Suddenly, he felt a warm hand creeping on his shoulder. His blue eyes quickly found their rightful owner, the man's lips curving up in a smile as soon as Castorice ended up in his line of sight.

"Hi," Phainon shifted his body to face the woman.

"Hey," Her giddy behaviour earned a raised brow from Phainon. "I might've drank too much."

Phainon laughed, "Oh, really?" He teased.

“Yes! Can’t you see?” Her movements were operatic and wobbly, resulting in a sudden loss of balance. Phainon managed to support the fall, Castorice's cheek then squished against his broad chest. Her posture was slumped and her limbs fell down her body from the lack of strength.

There was a minute of silence between them, followed by a sniffle. “I miss Cifera.”

Phainon cooed, patting her back in hopes of easing the big feelings she was experiencing. He would be lying if he said he didn't feel the exact same way about Mydei. He wanted to go home too.

Not seeing any progress with Castorice, he gently held held her in place as he stood back and slowly guided them towards the coatroom. Her wobbly walk made things difficult, but as soon as he found a table to finally put down the alcohol, things seemed to go more smoothly. With his freed hands Castorice was escorted to their first destination.

"Do you have your key?" Phainon asked while making his way to his own locker, his own key in the palm of his hand. He hoped Castorice wasn't clumsy enough to lose something so important while in that state, wincing mentally at the thought of a key search in a building as big as this.

Still not turning back, he heard the rustling of clothes and a few groans, followed by a loud enough "aha!". Phainon didn't even realised the audible exhale and the hand on his own key inside the keyhole stuck in a suspense. He finally twisted it and opened his own locker, his eyes falling onto a shiny bag.

A smile crept on his lips as his mind came back to the ceremony a few hours before and him standing on stage, receiving the trophy that was now placed inside of the bag.

"I'm done," Castorice stood next to Phainon, making him jump from the sudden sound.

"Oh, right, yeah."

He made quick work with the rest of his stuff, which wasn't even that much to begin with.

During the walk to the entrance his hand never left Castorice's shoulder, insuring a certain and immediate help in case she decided to wobble again.

“Should we go to the toilet? I will hold your hair,” Phainon, sitting next to her, asked as he started moving his body, ready to leave at any moment.

“Nooo…”

"Are you sure?"

She scrunched her face. “Call Cifera please,” Her hands searched her body to find a phone.

“It might be in your purse,” Phainon suggested kindly after noticing a small bag on the stairs next to her.

She quickly looked down to open it, search for the phone as well as a drunk person could, and sloppily handed it to Phainon. “Don’t drop it, please,” She said after almost doing so herself. At least her manners were still there.

Phainon looked at it and decided it's better to not ask for the phone code. The state she was in was far from cooperative and it would take them longer to unlock it than by him simply picking the emergency contacts and hoping for the best. The list wasn’t long, as it contained only three people. He clicked the “C” contact as the other ones were her parents.

It took a few seconds of listening to some sort of punk song before Castorice's girlfriend picked up. “Ugh, finally. Are you coming home now?” A soft voice could be heard from the other side, full of worry and affection.

“Um, hi,” Phainon said awkwardly, suddenly unable to find a good way to start this conversation.

“Who the fuck are you?” The change of tone on the other end was instant, her voice both aggressive and slightly scared. “She hung up?” Cas finally lifted her head up. Her eyes immediately glanced at the “C” on the screen switching to her wallpaper of the two of them together having fun at some sort of amusement park. Her sad drunken face reminded Phainon of a puppy. The big purple eyes were shining under the moon's light, looking between Phainon and her phone in his hand, lost and unable to read the situation.

“She will be here soon, Castorice,” That seemed to be a poor attempt of cheering her up. The other streamer frowned. "I promise."

"Okay..." She said, hugging her knees again. She seemed to believe him. "My head's killing me."

Well, that was definitely unexpected. Phainon couldn't contain his laugh. "See, and now you're laughing at me!" His laughter grew even bigger.

"Castorice, I really don't mind any of that. You seem like a really nice person," His hand dived in his pants' pocket to give her a tissue. "And," He blushed, hand going up to scratch his neck. "I'm really happy to hear I'm someone's inspiration."

"Oooh, what a catch," Though she didn't want it to show, she looked slightly surprised, as if Mydei being Phainon's type in a man was something unexpected.

"Indeed, it is." He put his phone back into the pocket, smug.

"Well, if I—" The wandering hands under Cifera's shirt stopped her from continuing her thought. She shrieked, her hands immediately wrapping around the naughty ones in hopes to stop them, face fully red.

"Cifera…" Castorice purred, nuzzling her nose against her neck. She put more of her weight onto the other woman.

"You should check your phone," She winked before walking towards her car while trying to wrestle the taller, and apparently stronger, person that constantly mumbled something in her ear. Not a fair fight at all, Castorice.

Phainon looked down to his pocket and took it out again to check what Cifera meant by that. His eyes got hit with a bright sight of the time, currently two hours and thirty seven minutes after midnight, a picture of his boyfriend smiling while holding a small orange kitten mid-meow next to his face and a bunch of notifications that he didn't hear due to having the "Do not disturb" mode on.

His eyes lit up when a familiar name could be seen on the bottom, nearly covered by other notifications from his friends and family. His finger scrolled to see the messages left by his boyfriend and his heart tugged in his chest. The last, shortest message was a simple 'I miss you', sent almost three hours ago, but it didn't stop Phainon from almost tearing up.

He spun on his heel and practically ran back to the stairs to retrieve his personal stuff and the award, and called for taxi to go back home as soon as possible.

Long lashes rested on his tan skin, his lips slightly parted as he laid there, their coziest blanket wrapped around his body to keep him warm. Mydei was still holding his phone with the black "The stream has ended" screen still open, which meant that he sent the message and fell asleep soon after the main stream, and therefore the ceremony, ended. Phainon cooed mentally, admiring his boyfriend and his ridiculous cuteness.

Mydei giggled as he wrapped his arms around the streamers head, pulling him closer to link them in a hug. The younger nudged his partner's head like a cat welcoming his owner and buried his nose below the jaw to inhale his natural scent mixed with his favourite cologne. The same one Mydei bought him for his birthday that year. "You smell good…" One of his hands brushed the white locks in a slow, smooth motion, bringing the familiar comfort to Phainon.

"Alright, come on," Phainon, leant over the couch and still buried in the crook of Mydei's neck, slowly unwrapped his partner from the covers. He noticed the white top and fluffy pink pyjama pants Mydei was wearing, as well as socks that matched his lower half of the outfit. Adorable. It was one of the first things they have bought together as a couple, the clothes still holding out strong despite a few years of use.

It wasn't long till the Kremnoan loosened his grip, allowing Phainon to straighten up a little, which simultaneously helped him sit up. The sleepyhead sluggishly moved his legs to the ground to properly sit on the couch, yet he made no other moves, his head falling to the side.
